title: Biochemical and biophysical characterization of PADI4 supports its involvement in cancer.
authors: Neira, Jose L; Araujo-Abad, Salome; Camara-Artigas, Ana; Rizzuti, Bruno; Abian, Olga; Giudici, Ana Marcela; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian; de Juan Romero, Camino
one_liner_zh: 该文表征PADI4蛋白的生化与生物物理性质及其在癌症中的表达，虽含分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-精氨酸脱亚胺酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及DNA结合或互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PADI4 (protein-arginine deiminase, also known as protein l-arginine iminohydrolase) is one of the human isoforms of a family of Ca(2+)-dependent proteins catalyzing the conversion of arginine to citrulline. Although the consequences of this process, known as citrullination, are not fully understood, all PADIs have been suggested to play essential roles in development and cell differentiation. They have been found in a wide range of cells and tissues and, among them, PADI4 is present in macrophages, monocytes, granulocytes and cancer cells. In this work, we focused on the biophysical features of PADI4 and, more importantly, how its expression was altered in cancer cells. Firstly, we described the different expression patterns of PADI4 in various cancer cell lines and its colocalization with the tumor-related protein p53. Secondly, we carried out a biophysical characterization of PADI4, by using a combination of biophysical techniques and in silico molecular dynamics simulations. Our biochemical results suggest the presence of several forms of PADI4 with different subcellular localizations, depending on the cancer cell line. Furthermore, PADI4 could have a major role in tumorigenesis by regulating p53 expression in certain cancer cell lines. On the other hand, the native structure of PADI4 was strongly pH-dependent both in the absence or presence of Ca(2+), and showed two pH-titrations at basic and acidic pH values. Thus, there was a narrow pH range (from 6.5 to 8.0) where the protein was dimeric and had a native structure, supporting its role in histones citrullination. Thermal denaturations were always two-state, but guanidinium-induced ones showed that PADI4 unfolded through at least one intermediate. Our simulation results suggest that the thermal melting of PADI4 structure was rather homogenous throughout its sequence. The overall results are discussed in terms of the functional role of PADI4 in the development of cancer.
abstract_zh: PADI4（蛋白精氨酸脱亚氨酶，又称蛋白L-精氨酸亚胺水解酶）是Ca(2+)依赖性蛋白家族中的人类亚型之一，该家族催化精氨酸转化为瓜氨酸。尽管这一过程（称为瓜氨酸化）的后果尚未完全明了，但所有PADIs被认为在发育和细胞分化中发挥关键作用。它们存在于多种细胞和组织中，其中PADI4存在于巨噬细胞、单核细胞、粒细胞和癌细胞中。在本研究中，我们聚焦于PADI4的生物物理特性，更重要的是其表达在癌细胞中如何改变。首先，我们描述了PADI4在不同癌细胞系中的不同表达模式及其与肿瘤相关蛋白p53的共定位。其次，我们通过结合生物物理技术和计算机模拟分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 对PADI4进行了生物物理表征。我们的生化结果表明，PADI4存在多种形式，具有不同的亚细胞定位，具体取决于癌细胞系。此外，PADI4可能通过调节某些癌细胞系中的p53表达在肿瘤发生中发挥重要作用。另一方面，PADI4的天然结构在有无Ca(2+)的情况下均强烈依赖pH值，并在碱性和酸性pH值下显示出两次pH滴定。因此，存在一个狭窄的pH范围（从6.5到8.0），在此范围内蛋白质为二聚体且具有天然结构，支持其在组蛋白瓜氨酸化中的作用。热变性始终是两态的，但胍诱导的变性显示PADI4通过至少一个中间体展开。我们的模拟结果表明，PADI4结构的热熔解在其序列中相当均匀。总体结果在PADI4在癌症发展中的功能作用背景下进行了讨论。
